Shraddha Kapoor's film 'Etha' release date shifted

The release date of actress Shraddha Kapoor's film 'Etha' has been postponed. Originally scheduled for August 28, the film will now premiere on December 4, 2026. This change avoids a clash with the release of 'Khosla Ka Ghosla 2'. Another report suggests the postponement might be due to the impact of the film 'Toxic' or a strategic decision, and that 'Etha' will now clash with Prabhas's film 'Fauji'.
